title: Domain Meta
description: Per-feature metadata: src/features/<domain>/domain.meta.json. Owned by the lane that owns <domain>.

id.description: Domain id (kebab-case). Must equal the src/features/<id>/ directory name.

owner_lane.description: Which lane owns this domain (per docs/flows/AGENTS.md ownership matrix).

flow.description: Path (repo-relative) to the generated mermaid flow file for this domain.

edge_cases.description: Map of edge-state-id -> array of edge-case template names that apply.
